content.what_it_is: Commented (tutorial) MATLAB snapshot-plot script placed in the vessel_types_compare case but byte-identical to vessel_flat_bottom/postprocessing/plot_wave_vessel_commented.m (same SHA-256), so its user-input values still reflect the flat-bottom case. User inputs: fdir='output/' (L9), snapshot numbers nfile=[20 40] (L12), time labels times={'20' '40'} (L15). It loads eta_00001 for sizing (L20-L21), builds x,y with dx=dy=1.0 (L24-L27), sets an 8x5-inch figure (L30-L33), and per snapshot (L36-L61): zero-pads (L40), loads eta_<fnum> (L43), plots pcolor(x,y,eta) with flat shading in stacked subplots (L46-L49), fixes caxis [-1.5 1.5] (L52), titles ' Time = <times> sec ' (L54), labels y/x (L56-L57), forces zbuffer (L59). Stale commented export at L62.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
eta — surface elevation, sizing load then per snapshot (L20, L43)
